description: Elections Commission - Declare that U. D. A. Prema Kumar as a member of the Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Baddegama Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. The content specifically deals with the electoral process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination and declaration of a new elected member. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
